summary: Regime shift day: SKHY 7x oversubscribed ($171.5B orders, largest foreign ADR demand in history) invalidates the HBM4 distribution thesis and inverts the semiconductor narrative — 5 positions closed (2 stopped out, 3 thesis broken) including short-SMH and short-MU. Three new ideas added: long SKHY at July 10 debut (HBM4 pure play), long GLD on Iran Day 2 + stagflation dual-pillar, and long SMH as regime flip from failed short.
